title: Backend API Engineer
focus: Build TypeScript and Node.js REST API services backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. Improve query plans, caching and p95 latency. Ship Docker services on AWS using GitHub Actions CI/CD, integration tests and OpenTelemetry. This is an early-career position; do not require previous leadership.

title: Frontend React and Accessibility Engineer
focus: Build accessible React and Next.js workflows in TypeScript. Prioritize keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, reusable form components, validation and responsive UI. Write Playwright end-to-end tests. Strong evidence of accessible component and dashboard work matters more than backend tracing or data pipelines.

title: Full Stack TypeScript Engineer
focus: Build customer-facing React and Next.js interfaces together with Node.js REST API endpoints and PostgreSQL storage. Implement accessible form workflows, query optimization and integration tests. Ship through GitHub Actions CI/CD and Docker. Select work showing both UI and backend delivery rather than unrelated algorithms exercises.

title: QA Automation Engineer / SDET
focus: Own test automation for web forms and backend APIs. Write Playwright browser tests for authentication, keyboard navigation, validation and screen-reader labels, plus Jest unit tests and integration tests in GitHub Actions CI/CD. Favor entries with concrete test counts and regression prevention. Development experience is useful when it demonstrates test coverage.

title: Junior Python and SQL Data Engineer
focus: Build Python ingestion and validation pipelines for structured datasets. Use SQL for duplicate detection, data-quality checks, reports and reproducible processing. Prioritize experiment records, transport data, transaction parsing and weather observations. PostgreSQL query performance and Linux documentation are useful. Frontend components and Java game algorithms are less relevant.

title: Observability and Platform Engineer
focus: Build developer tooling for observable Node.js services. Instrument OpenTelemetry traces, expose Redis queue health signals, compare deployment runs, and analyze PostgreSQL latency. Package with Docker and automate GitHub Actions CI/CD on AWS. Favor monitoring, tracing, debugging, reproducible Linux environments and cache benchmarking over unrelated UI and algorithm work.
